editorial.blurb: Galit is a rare gem where Mediterranean cuisine reaches new heights—every dish is beautifully executed with intention, from the silky hummus to the perfectly smoked pastrami.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for the tasting menu and don't skip the hummus and falafel; portions are generous, so pace yourself and consider taking leftovers home. Try the Pastrami over the Smoked Turkey Shawarma if you can only choose one.
